canonical_statement: For measurable events A_n in a probability space whose finite probability sums diverge, the probability of limsup A_n is at least the limsup of the squared finite probability sum divided by the ordered double sum of pairwise-intersection probabilities.
domain_and_universes: Omega : Type u; MeasurableSpace Omega; mu : Measure Omega; IsProbabilityMeasure mu; A : Nat -> Set Omega; Prop in universe 0
conclusion: Filter.limsup (eventMassRatio mu A) atTop <= mu.real (limsup A atTop), where both finite sums use Finset.range n and the denominator is the ordered n-by-n double sum.
minimal_import_evidence: This pinned module directly supplies Measure, IsProbabilityMeasure, MeasurableSet, event limsup notation, and the filter/topology infrastructure used by the target. No repository Stage1 module or broader Mathlib umbrella is imported.
pinned_source_relationship: The definitions and root proposition directly normalize the intake-selected lower-bound candidate. The legacy S1_M_289 module is not imported and supplies no proof credit.
